{{Top|leg}}
'''Stun prods''' were weapons that could fire a short-range paralysis burst. It could also deliver a nonlethal stun jolt if placed in direct contact with a target.<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref> Stun prods were used by [[Slaver/Legends|slavers]] aligned with the [[Karazak Slavers' Cooperative/Legends|Karazak Slavers Cooperative]] to corral their [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]].<ref name="BG">{{JournalCite|8|Blaze of Glory (short story)}}</ref> [[G-2RD series guard droid]]s were equipped with a stun prod.<ref name="EGTD" />
